scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,TV "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm test
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,TV "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
